title: POST /users returns 500 when email is missing
description: When someone creates a new user and forgets to fill in the email, the server crashes and shows a technical error instead of a clear message. It should tell the person "email is required" so they can fix it and try again. Right now they get a confusing failure and no user is created.
preconditions: Valid bearer token for a standard user
steps: Send POST /users with a valid token and body {"name": "qa_auto_1a2b3c4d"} (no email field)
Observe the status code and response body
expected: 400 Bad Request with a validation error for 'email' (OpenAPI: email is required in UserCreate)
actual: 500 Internal Server Error with body {"error":"NullPointerException at UserService"}
notes: Response also leaks an internal class name.
